brief:
Gaza police arrested two suspects and recovered 140,000 shekels within two hours of responding to a robbery report, Shehab Wire reported. Officers from the al-Ramla precinct in Gaza City traced the theft from a residential apartment and apprehended the suspects while securing the stolen cash.

The investigation resolved the case swiftly after police received the initial complaint about the missing funds.

title: Gaza police arrest two suspects in 140,000-shekel apartment theft
